high_level_description: The image shows a person being interviewed outdoors on a sunny day. The individual is holding a microphone with the logo "DOSE OF SOCIETY" prominently displayed on it. They appear to be speaking, as suggested by their open mouth and engaged expression. The person has shoulder-length dark hair and is wearing a brown sweater with a zipper. A black handbag with a gold chain strap is slung over their shoulder. The background features a street scene with yellow buildings, some of which have classical architectural details like columns.
